info.title: Primus Portal local profile realtime API
info.description: N31 same-origin, session-guarded projection observation transport. This contract describes Portal-local cursor/revision metadata only. Browsers never receive Manager relation selectors, source cursors, delegated JWTs, mTLS material, or a route to Execution Edge.

get.description: Pins the current Portal-local projection revision before a stream opens. The body is unchanged. An explicitly installed native selection adds X-Portal-Realtime-State and, only for NATIVE_SCOPED_BASELINE_V1, X-Portal-Realtime-Cursor. Use this HEADER cursor for the native notification-only stream, never the legacy body cursor. READ does not grant STREAM. Header absence retains legacy behavior. NATIVE_SCOPED_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE permits READ only. This is not a browser-to-Edge route or source qualification claim.

X-Portal-Realtime-State.description: Optional native protocol discriminator. Absent for legacy transport; read-only native configurations return NATIVE_SCOPED_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE without a cursor.

X-Portal-Realtime-Cursor.description: Present only with NATIVE_SCOPED_BASELINE_V1. Opaque actor/workspace/profile/source-bound READ baseline, not STREAM authority. Never decode, share across actors or reuse after revocation/generation changes.

get.description: Legacy transport streams Portal-local snapshot, delta, heartbeat, auth-expired and projection-gap envelopes. For an explicitly installed native selection whose snapshot returned NATIVE_SCOPED_BASELINE_V1, each data frame is instead ScopedRealtimeFrame with NOTIFICATION_ONLY semantics: revalidate, heartbeat, resync_required, access_revoked or unavailable. Current STREAM is checked independently; READ or a cursor never grants it. Last-Event-ID takes precedence over cursor in both protocols. Terminal native frames contain no protected cursor/generation/quality. Resnapshot only via the same-origin snapshot route. Default and retained configurations do not activate native streaming.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Initial Portal-local opaque projection cursor. Required only when Last-Event-ID is absent.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Last delivered Portal-local cursor. It takes precedence over cursor on EventSource reconnect.

200.description: text/event-stream; each SSE data frame is one versioned Portal-local observation envelope.
